generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: Launch: 63 kWh usable (Engage FWD) and 87 kWh usable packs; DC up to 130 kW (CCS1). US last model year 2025; Canada continues (2026 unchanged, 2027 facelift with NACS). The facelift keeps the same packs and 130 kW, so it is not split; add a 2027 facelift entry only if its curve turns out to differ. Model-level last_year left open because Canada continues. Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending).
